passive.name: Long Night
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **36/42/48/54/60%**. Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Skill and Ultimate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate, gains "Somnus Corpus." Upon triggering a Follow-Up ATK, consumes "Somnus Corpus," and increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK by **48/56/64/72/80%**.

passive.name: Meteor Swarm
passive.text: For every enemy on the field, increases the wearer's ATK by **9/10.5/12/13.5/15%**, up to 5 stacks. When an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, the DMG dealt by the wearer increases by **30/35/40/45/50%** for 1 turn.

passive.name: Each Now Has a Role to Play
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by **24/30/36/42/48%** for **3** turn(s).

passive.name: Boundless Thought
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **8/9/10/11/12%**. After using an attack, for each enemy target hit, additionally increases ATK by **4/5/6/7/8%**. This effect can stack up to 5 times and last until the next attack. If there are **3** or more enemy targets hit, this unit's SPD increases by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: A Storm Is Coming
passive.text: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by **0.2/0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4%**. A max of **160** Energy will be taken into account for this.

passive.name: Stratagem
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/18/20/22/24%**. When the wearer uses an attack and at least 2 attacked enemies have the corresponding Weakness, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by **20/25/30/35/40%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Get Ready
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DMG by **12/15/18/21/24%**. For every enemy defeated by the wearer, the wearer's ATK increases by **4/5/6/7/8%**, stacking up to **3** time(s).

passive.name: Quiescence
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **28/35/42/49/56%**. After the wearer uses Ultimate, increases SPD by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint) = CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: Sawblade Tuning
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Himeko's ATK to one enemy.

entries.name: Molten Detonation
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **200%** of Himeko's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG equal to **80%** of Himeko's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

entries.name: Heavenly Flare
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **230%** of Himeko's ATK to all enemies. Himeko regenerates **5** extra Energy for each enemy defeated.

entries.name: Victory Rush
entries.text:
When an enemy target is inflicted with Weakness Break, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge (max **3** points).
If Himeko is fully Charged when an ally target performs an attack, Himeko immediately performs 1 Follow-Up ATK and deals Fire DMG equal to **140%** of her ATK to all enemies, consuming all Charge points.
At the start of the battle, Himeko gains 1 point of Charge.

entries.name: Incomplete Combustion
entries.text: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for **15** second(s). After entering battle with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a **100%** base chance to increase Fire DMG taken by enemies by **10%** for **2** turn(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

entries.name: Starfire
entries.text:
After using an attack, there is a **50%** base chance to inflict Burn on enemies, lasting for **2** turn(s).
When afflicted with Burn, enemies take Fire DoT equal to **30%** of Himeko's ATK at the start of each turn.

entries.name: Magma
entries.text: Skill deals **20%** more DMG to enemies currently afflicted with Burn.

entries.name: Benchmark
entries.text: When current HP percentage is **80%** or higher, CRIT Rate increases by **15%**.

entries.name: Childhood
entries.text: After "Victory Rush" is triggered, Himeko's SPD increases by 20% for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: Convergence
entries.text: Deals 15% more DMG to enemies whose HP percentage is 50% or less.

entries.name: Poised
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Dedication
entries.text: When Himeko's Skill inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, she gains 1 extra point(s) of Charge.

entries.name: Aspiration
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Trailblaze!
entries.text: Ultimate deals 2 extra instances of Fire DMG equal to 40% of the original DMG to one random enemy.
